title: SharePoint: Copilot in SharePoint, with advanced work billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The availability, licensing, credit warning and documented controls are supported by Microsoft's sources. The briefing correctly reports the conflicting rollout descriptions and the retirement of preview settings. One minor issue remains: the checklist asks administrators to configure spending policies, but the controls table does not cover that control.
